name: Zade's wallpaper
tagline: Draw on your home screen with coloured shapes
blurb: Zade's wallpaper lets you draw with shapes on your background, and adds random shapes when you're not drawing.
description:
Zade's wallpaper lets you draw with shapes on your background, and adds random shapes when you're not drawing.

Every feature can be turned on or off, you can change the background colour and shape colour, select shape types, and much more.

Features:
- Very customisable
- Lots of different shape types
- Supports Material 3 icon theming
- Amoled black option
- Multi-touch support
